name: Understand Anything
description: Native OpenClaw gateway plugin for Understand-Anything: tree-sitter + LLM knowledge-graph pipeline running inside the gateway process, with a gateway-mounted dashboard and query tools — no Claude Code / Task-tool dispatch required.
author: Egonex (https://github.com/Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything), OpenClaw port by Tank

anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key for the LLM enrichment phase. Falls back to the gateway's default anthropic:default auth profile when unset.

model.description: Anthropic model id used for file/project/layer/tour analysis calls.

concurrency.description: Max concurrent per-file LLM analysis calls during a project scan.

maxFiles.description: Safety cap on how many recognized source files a single analysis run will send to the LLM (cost/runtime bound on large repos).

projects.description: Absolute paths to projects this plugin is allowed to analyze/serve. Analysis and dashboard routes only operate on directories listed here; when empty or unset the plugin activates but every tool reports an empty project list.

allowAddProject.description: Let the dashboard's 'Add a project' form register new projects at runtime — by GitHub URL (shallow-cloned into ~/.local/share/understand-anything-plugin/clones) or an existing local path — without editing config or restarting the gateway. Off by default: the projects allowlist above is otherwise the only way to expand what this plugin can read/analyze/serve, and this setting relaxes that for anyone who can reach the dashboard route.

graphify.description: Optional second analysis engine: Graphify (deterministic tree-sitter extraction over 40+ languages + community clustering, no LLM required). When configured, analyses can run engine native, graphify, or both (both = native graph enriched and merged with graphify output, provenance-tagged).

dir.description: Path to a uv-managed graphify checkout (runs `uv run --project <dir> graphify`).

cmd.description: Explicit command override for invoking the graphify CLI (e.g. ["graphify"] for a pip install). Takes precedence over dir.

timeoutMs.description: Hard deadline on a graphify subprocess run.

engine.description: Default analysis engine when the tool call doesn't specify one. Defaults to both when graphify is configured, native otherwise.

allowAddProject.label: Allow Adding Projects From the Dashboard
